parts:
I’m converting from Mplus to lavaan for both research and teaching purposes. With one exception, I was easily able to mimic the vast majority of my Mplus modules using lavaan. The exception has me stumped and I’m hoping someone on this forum may be able to help me. Specifically, I cannot mimic my Mplus single indicator approach to operationalizing the latent variables. The approach I use is to fix the lambda from the latent variable to its manifest indicator (average of a set of items representing some construct) to the square root of that manifest variable’ reliability (composite reliability), and then I fix the error-uniqueness term to (1 minus the reliability) times the variance of the manifest indicator. The following is the syntax and the output. I thank all of you in advance for taking a look and correcting the error of my ways. FYI - it’s a multi-sample example.

Bob Vandenberg

+ #fixed loadings and error-uniqueness terms
+ AvgFitFx =~ a(.913,.92)*AvgFit

+ Afft1Fx =~ c(.957, .958)*AffAvgt1
+ AffAvgt1 ~~ d(.085, .081)*AffAvgt1
+
+ Trnt1Fx =~ e(.922, .921)*TrnAvgt1
+ TrnAvgt1 ~~f(.119, .123)*TrnAvgt1
+
+ #Path Model
+ Afft1Fx ~ AvgFitFx
+ Trnt1Fx ~ AvgFitFx
+ NPVHC ~ AvgFitFx + Trnt1Fx'
> path.model.time1fitSI<-sem(time1.model.SI, data=MGMT9610r, group = "JobSeek", meanstructure = TRUE, mimic = "mplus")

Hi Bob,
I think Ed’s comment was that you should be using the c() function. So, this

AvgFitFx =~ a(.913,.92)*AvgFit
 AvgFit ~~ b(.107, .094)*AvgFit

 Afft1Fx =~ c(.957, .958)*AffAvgt1
 AffAvgt1 ~~ d(.085, .081)*AffAvgt1

 Trnt1Fx =~ e(.922, .921)*TrnAvgt1
 TrnAvgt1 ~~f(.119, .123)*TrnAvgt1

would be

AvgFitFx =~ c(.913,.92)*AvgFit
 AvgFit ~~ c(.107, .094)*AvgFit

 Afft1Fx =~ c(.957, .958)*AffAvgt1
 AffAvgt1 ~~ c(.085, .081)*AffAvgt1

 Trnt1Fx =~ c(.922, .921)*TrnAvgt1
 TrnAvgt1 ~~ c(.119, .123)*TrnAvgt1
